The practice does not use the owner's fear of penalties, of their bank or of their tax authority as leverage; it does not close an upgrade or extract a commitment in the conversation where distress was disclosed; it slows down, puts options in writing and lets the owner decide without same-call pressure. There is a hard limit at the other end: work outside the paid scope is not continued indefinitely out of sympathy, because an unpaid account is subsidised by every client who does pay. Two boundaries are absolute. The practice never advises on insolvency, restructuring, tax deferral or creditor priority - that is licensed territory, referred out the moment it appears. And client records are never held hostage to a fee dispute; what a departing or defaulting client is entitled to receive, and in what form and timeframe, is governed by the engagement terms and by local professional and legal rules, so verify current obligations in your jurisdiction with a qualified professional before acting on any records or work-stop decision.

included: early written contact and structured options
care obligations for owners under strain
a stated limit on continued unpaid delivery
the licensed-territory referral for insolvency, restructuring and tax deferral
records-return governed by terms and local rules
excluded: insolvency, restructuring or creditor-priority advice
third-party collections litigation and its conduct rules
any assertion about what local law requires without verification

pros.claim: A pre-written protocol keeps behaviour consistent in exactly the situation where improvisation causes harm
pros.example: the same option set offered to an owner who lost their largest customer as to one who simply went quiet

pros.claim: Structured options preserve dignity and often preserve the relationship for the recovery
pros.example: a client who paused for a season and returned to the same practice when trade came back

cons.claim: Patience has a real cost that is paid by the rest of the book
cons.example: two cycles of continued work for an account that never resumes paying

cons.claim: Judging genuine distress from avoidance is difficult and mistakes cut both ways
cons.example: extending terms for an account that was quietly moving to another provider

failure_modes: continuing full delivery for months while saying nothing about non-payment
using penalty or tax-authority fear to force payment
drifting into insolvency or tax-deferral advice because the owner had nobody else to ask
withholding the client ledger or records as leverage in a fee dispute
acceptance_tests: every distressed or non-paying account has dated written contact, an option set and a stated limit on continued delivery
no message in these accounts uses penalty, authority or consequence framing beyond what the engagement terms state
the records position and any work-stop decision cite the engagement terms and a jurisdiction verification note
revisit_triggers: an account passes the stated limit without resolution
engagement terms, professional guidance or local rules on records and work stoppage change
a distress case reveals the option set did not fit the situation

base.update_signal: a resolved distress case or a change in local records, work-stoppage or professional-conduct obligations affecting what the protocol may do

nodes.definition: Give seasonal businesses terms that survive their quiet months, because the default subscription arrangement breaks precisely when their revenue does. A landscaper, a tax-season-adjacent professional, a holiday retailer or a summer tourism operator generates most of its transactions in part of the year, but the practice still reconciles, still files nothing in the quiet months yet still holds the account, and the owner still sees a full fee leave their account in a month where nothing happened. Three mechanisms exist, each stated in writing before the first quiet month rather than negotiated during it. Annualized leveling prices the whole year of scope as a level monthly fee, which smooths the practice cash flow and the client's, and is defensible only if the annual scope was actually estimated from measured effort; its cost is that the client experiences the quiet months as paying for nothing, so the leveling is explained up front and restated when it bites. An explicit dormant tier reduces both fee and scope in named months to a genuinely smaller service - feeds monitored, ledger kept current, no full reporting packet - which is honest but requires the reduced service to be real and to be delivered. A pause with a defined restart date is the last option and carries a capacity consequence that must be stated: the seat either holds the slot open, which costs capacity, or releases it, which means the returning client re-enters through the admission gate. Whichever mechanism is chosen, the peak-month workload is what must be staffed, and seasonal accounts are placed on seats whose other clients peak in different quarters.

included: annualized leveling with its explanation duty
an explicit dormant tier with genuinely reduced service
pause with a stated capacity consequence
peak-month staffing and counter-seasonal placement
excluded: the tier architecture itself
the client's own cash-flow or tax planning
informally skipping months without written terms

pros.claim: Written seasonal terms prevent the quiet-month cancellation that would otherwise cost the whole year
pros.example: a landscaping client who understood in advance why the winter fee stays level and did not treat it as a surprise

pros.claim: Counter-seasonal placement lets the practice serve seasonal clients without paying for their peaks twice
pros.example: pairing a summer-peaking trades client with a client whose heaviest quarter is the winter holidays

cons.claim: Level pricing is hardest to defend exactly when the client has least cash, so it needs re-explaining at the worst moment
cons.example: a quiet-month call where the owner asks what they are paying for this month

cons.claim: A pause that holds the slot open consumes capacity that generates nothing
cons.example: a seat carrying an empty slot for several months for a client who may not return

failure_modes: leveling a fee without having estimated the annual scope from measured effort
offering a dormant tier and then delivering the full service anyway
pausing with no restart date and no capacity decision
staffing to average months and missing the peak
acceptance_tests: every seasonal account has a written mechanism, its months named, and the capacity consequence recorded
leveled fees trace to an annual scope estimate built from measured effort
dormant-tier accounts show the reduced service actually delivered in the named months
revisit_triggers: a client's seasonal pattern shifts
a paused client fails to restart on the agreed date
peak-month delivery slipped for a seasonal cohort

base.update_signal: seasonal cohort retention and delivered-effort data across a full year showing whether leveling, dormant tiers or pauses held better

nodes.definition: Decide in advance what makes a client a mis-fit, and end those relationships in a way that leaves the client whole and the practice defensible. The criteria are written while nobody is angry, and they are structural rather than emotional: an account that stays underwater after a rung conversation and a scope correction have both been offered and refused; a client who will not supply what the work requires despite repeated written requests, so the books cannot be kept accurately; a client who repeatedly pushes the practice toward work that requires a licence or toward positions the practice will not take; a client whose treatment of the team crosses into abuse; a client whose business has moved outside what the practice can competently serve; and non-payment that has passed the limit set in the distress protocol. Exit itself follows a sequence: decide against the written criteria and record the reason; give notice in the form and period the engagement terms require; state the last period the practice will close and what will and will not be finished; assemble the offboarding pack including the ledger through that period in a portable form, reconciliation status, open items and where documents live; offer a short, defined transition window for the successor bookkeeper's questions; revoke every credential and confirm the revocation in writing. Two rules cannot bend. The client is never held hostage - records they are entitled to are handed over regardless of the dispute, with the entitlement and timing governed by the engagement terms and local professional and legal rules, which must be verified in your jurisdiction with a qualified professional. And the reason is stated plainly, without blame, in one written sentence, because a mis-fit client who leaves respected talks about the practice very differently from one who leaves humiliated - and in a niche, that difference travels.

included: written structural exit criteria decided in advance
notice, last-close statement and the offboarding pack
a defined transition window for the successor
credential revocation with written confirmation
no records held hostage
excluded: legal action, liens or dispute litigation, which is referred out
commenting on the client to their successor, their CPA or their peers beyond the facts they authorize
using exit as a threat inside a pricing conversation

pros.claim: Pre-written criteria let an exit be a decision rather than an eruption after a bad week
pros.example: ending an account against the underwater-and-refused criterion instead of after a rude email

pros.claim: A clean handover protects the practice reputation in the small community the client belongs to
pros.example: a departing restaurant owner telling their association the handover was faultless

cons.claim: Exits cost immediate revenue and capacity does not always refill in the same cycle
cons.example: a seat with an open slot for two cycles after an exit while the queue is thin

cons.claim: Assembling a proper offboarding pack for a client who is leaving badly is real unpaid work
cons.example: days of export, reconciliation notes and open-item listing for an account that stopped paying

failure_modes: exiting in anger with no written criterion behind the decision
delaying or degrading the handover because the client behaved badly
holding records or delaying exports as leverage over an unpaid balance
leaving credentials live after the relationship has ended
explaining the exit to the client peers or successor in terms that damage them
acceptance_tests: the exit criteria exist in writing and every exit cites the criterion it met
each exit shows notice per the engagement terms, an offboarding pack delivered, and dated confirmation of credential revocation
no exit in the record shows records withheld, and the jurisdiction verification note is present on the records position
revisit_triggers: an exit produces a dispute, a complaint or reputational damage
the same criterion fires repeatedly, indicating a qualification or scope problem upstream
engagement terms or local records obligations change

base.update_signal: exit outcomes including disputes, referrals from departed clients, and any change in local records-handover obligations

nodes.definition: Build referral flow from tax professionals and licensed accountants on the one thing they actually care about: that work arriving from this practice is clean and that nothing is being taken from them. The mechanism is specific. What the CPA gets is a client whose books close on a schedule, whose ledger arrives in a predictable format with reconciliations done and open items listed, and whose questions have been triaged so the CPA is not billing hours to chase a bank statement. What the practice promises is a boundary it visibly does not cross: no returns, no tax positions, no representation, no advising the shared client on anything reserved, and every question of that kind routed back to the CPA rather than answered helpfully. The relationship is built by delivering that experience on shared clients first - the referral follows the evidence, not a lunch - and by making the handoff artifact so reliable that the CPA prefers this practice to whatever they usually receive. Information discipline is absolute in both directions: nothing about a client is discussed with a CPA who is not already engaged by that client without the client's specific authorization, and a referral introduction is made by connecting people, not by forwarding financial detail. Any arrangement involving fees, commissions or incentives between professionals touches professional-conduct and disclosure rules that differ by jurisdiction and profession, so the safe default is no fee-sharing, full disclosure to the client of any relationship that could look like an incentive, and verification of current rules in your jurisdiction with a qualified professional before entering any arrangement of that kind.

included: the clean-handoff mechanism that earns referrals
the visible boundary promise that makes a CPA safe
client authorization before any information passes
disclosure and jurisdiction verification for any incentive arrangement
excluded: performing any of the licensed work the CPA does
entering fee-sharing or commission arrangements without verified local rules and client disclosure
discussing a shared client's affairs without documented authorization

pros.claim: A referral built on a delivered handoff is durable because it rests on the CPA own experience rather than on goodwill
pros.example: a tax professional who sends a second client after a year-end where nothing had to be chased

pros.claim: The boundary promise converts a potential competitor into a source of work
pros.example: a CPA who refers monthly bookkeeping precisely because this practice never touches the return

cons.claim: The relationship is slow to build and depends on shared clients existing first
cons.example: months of clean year-ends before the first unprompted referral arrives

cons.claim: Referral dependence concentrates risk in a small number of relationships
cons.example: a book where a large share of new clients trace to one retiring tax professional

failure_modes: answering a shared client tax question helpfully and destroying the boundary promise in one conversation
sharing client information with a professional the client has not engaged or authorized
entering an incentive or fee-share arrangement without disclosure or verified local rules
chasing referrals socially while the handoff artifact stays messy
acceptance_tests: shared-client handoffs in the last cycle met the agreed format and timing with open items listed
every information exchange with a professional has a documented client authorization
no arrangement involving fees or incentives exists without written client disclosure and a jurisdiction verification note
revisit_triggers: a shared-client handoff is late or incomplete
a boundary incident occurs on a shared client
referral concentration passes the practice tolerance
professional-conduct guidance on referral arrangements changes

base.update_signal: referral volume and quality traced to specific professional relationships after a period of clean handoffs, or a change in professional-conduct rules on referral arrangements

nodes.definition: Turn satisfied clients and the niche communities they belong to into a repeatable source of introductions without buying, faking or leaking anything. The engine has three parts. Earned standing: showing up in the places the niche already gathers - a trade association, a regional operators group, a franchise owners network, a specialist online forum - and being useful there in a way that does not require any client's data, by explaining how bookkeeping mechanics work for that trade in general terms, answering the recurring operational questions, and being visibly consistent over time rather than appearing when the pipeline is empty. Asked introductions: the ask is made to clients who have shown evidence of value - they use the reporting, the review call is engaged, delivery has been clean for a stretch - and it is specific rather than vague, naming the kind of business the practice serves well, and it is made in a way that is easy to decline without cost to the relationship. Consent and honesty: no client name, logo, numbers, situation or story is used without that client's specific written permission; no invented testimonial, borrowed screenshot or implied client is ever presented; any incentive offered for a referral is disclosed to both sides in plain terms, and no incentive is offered where it could distort a professional's judgment. The engine is deliberately slow, and it is measured by introductions actually made rather than by activity, because a practice can attend a community for a year and produce nothing if it has never once been specific about what a good introduction looks like.

included: earned standing in the places the niche already gathers
asking only clients showing evidence of value, specifically and declinably
written permission before any client identity or detail is used
disclosure of any referral incentive
excluded: fabricated testimonials, invented results or implied clients
using client data or identity without written permission
the offer positioning and messaging itself, owned by the offer and niche selection KB

pros.claim: Introductions inside a niche arrive pre-qualified because the referrer knows what the practice does
pros.example: a trades operator introducing a peer with the same job-costing question their own reporting answers

pros.claim: Asking only clients with evidence of value keeps the ask honest and protects the relationship
pros.example: asking the client who quotes their own margin numbers back on the review call, not the one who never opens the packet

cons.claim: Community standing takes sustained time that produces nothing measurable for a long stretch
cons.example: several months of association meetings before any introduction appears

cons.claim: Asking can strain a relationship if the timing or the client experience is misread
cons.example: an ask made in the same month the client chased a late reporting packet

failure_modes: appearing in the community only when the pipeline is empty
using a client story or logo without written permission
asking vaguely so nobody knows who to introduce
offering an undisclosed incentive that would look like a kickback if the client learned of it
acceptance_tests: every client identity, story or number used externally has written permission on file
asks in the last period went only to accounts with a recorded value signal, and each ask names the kind of business wanted
any incentive is disclosed in writing to both sides
revisit_triggers: introductions dry up despite continued community activity
a client declines an ask in a way that signals dissatisfaction
a permission expires or is withdrawn

base.update_signal: introductions actually made per client asked and per community engaged, showing which standing and which ask wording produced anything

nodes.definition: Hold one periodic meeting where the whole book is looked at as a portfolio rather than as a queue of accounts, and where decisions that are individually easy to defer are actually made. Its inputs are the outputs of everything else in this KB: seat load against the capacity band, the contribution ranking with cause tags, the drift and goodwill log, the carried legacy price gap, the at-risk register with its interventions and outcomes, the exits and admissions of the period, and concentration - how much of the book depends on one niche, one referral source, one seat or one client. Its outputs are decisions with owners and dates: which accounts move rung, which enter staged correction, which move to the exit conversation, whether intake reopens or stays closed, whether a seat needs load moved, and which cohort-level problem is worth fixing this period. The review is also where the practice checks itself against its own standards: were boundary events logged and referred, did the access review run, were concessions dated, did every fee change go out in writing with notice. Two habits make it work. It runs on a fixed schedule whether or not anything feels wrong, because the failures this review exists to catch are slow ones that never announce themselves. And it distinguishes busy from healthy: a book that is completely full, delivering on time, and quietly subsidising a third of its accounts is not healthy, and the review is the only place in the practice designed to notice that.

included: composed portfolio inputs across capacity, contribution, risk and price debt
concentration by niche, referral source, seat and client
decisions with owners and dates
a self-check against the practice own conduct and access standards
excluded: the individual close or account work itself
the design of tiers, niches or the offer, owned by the offer and niche selection KB
practice valuation, financing or statutory reporting

pros.claim: Composing the views catches the slow failures that no single account conversation reveals
pros.example: seeing that the accounts entering staged correction are the same ones that carry the practice referral flow

pros.claim: A fixed schedule forces decisions that are individually easy to postpone forever
pros.example: the third consecutive review finally closing the exit decision on a chronically underwater account

cons.claim: The review is only as good as the instruments feeding it, and a weak ledger makes a confident meeting produce wrong decisions
cons.example: ranking accounts for exit on estimated rather than measured effort

cons.claim: Portfolio thinking can override a legitimate account-specific judgment
cons.example: cutting a low-contribution client who was the practice route into a whole niche community

failure_modes: holding the review only when something feels wrong
reviewing metrics without closing any decision
skipping the self-check on boundary, access and conduct standards
mistaking a full book for a healthy one
acceptance_tests: the review ran on schedule with all composed inputs present or explicitly marked missing
every decision has an owner and a date and is traceable to the node that produced its evidence
the self-check on boundary events, access review, dated concessions and written fee changes is recorded with its findings
revisit_triggers: a review runs with missing inputs
decisions from the previous review were not executed
concentration in any dimension passes the practice stated tolerance
capacity or contribution instruments are re-derived

base.update_signal: a review cycle whose decisions were executed and whose outcomes show whether the composed inputs pointed at the right accounts

edges.why_related: the ledger exists to measure the cost-to-serve lever the economics model names, so what it captures is decided by that model
clients-per-seat is derived by dividing available delivery time by measured per-account effort, so capacity cannot be computed before the ledger runs
contribution sets fee against measured cost-to-serve, which only exists once effort is captured by category
smoothing allocates accounts inside a known capacity band; without the band there is nothing to smooth against
the gate asks whether an incoming account fits the calendar shape as well as the total, which requires the smoothing picture
rising effort without a rung change is the primary instrument that makes unpriced work visible
routing decides the destination of work that detection has already named and evidenced
the review needs a contribution position per account before any fee decision can be argued from evidence
the conversation delivers a decision the cadence has already made and evidenced
the accumulated gap is quantified and staged inside the scheduled review rather than in an ad-hoc moment
the review conversation works off the packet, so a packet the owner cannot read makes the call a social event
engagement signals are mostly observed in and around the recurring call, which is the sensor the risk set reads
the ladder selects a response by signal family, so it cannot act before the signals are named and classified
exit is the defined end of the ladder, entered only after the cause has been diagnosed and the rungs attempted or ruled out
the capacity band minus its reserve is the hard ceiling the gate enforces, and no commercial argument raises it
work requiring a licence is tested first and can only be declined and referred, never priced as an add-on however profitable
making reporting more useful must stop at describing what the books show and never become prescriptive tax, financing or structural advice
nothing about a client passes to a professional they have not engaged without documented client authorization, whatever the referral value
client identity, numbers and stories may only be used externally with specific written permission, which bounds every referral and community activity
save attempts may not use fear, urgency or consequence claims, and every concession must be dated, conditioned and equally available
the model rewards more accounts while the gate refuses them, so growth pressure and delivery capacity pull against each other every month
edges.resolution_rule: the capacity ceiling wins: revenue growth comes from mix, corrected pricing or added capacity, and an account is admitted beyond the band only when a named seat change or exit has already created the room

edges.why_related: naming a price for extra work is exactly what an at-risk client is least willing to hear, so scope discipline and save effort collide on the same account
edges.resolution_rule: the work is still named and evidenced; the practice may choose one logged goodwill instance while a documented intervention is in progress, but silent absorption is never permitted and a second instance forces the rung or exit conversation

edges.why_related: a scheduled correction landing on an account that is already showing risk signals can convert a recoverable relationship into a cancellation
edges.resolution_rule: if the risk cause is a service defect, repair it and defer the change by one cycle with the deferral documented; if the cause is structural or the account is materially underwater, proceed on cadence with full notice rather than hiding the position

edges.why_related: the fastest repayment of an accumulated gap is a single large correction, which is precisely what disclosure-first, no-pressure conduct forbids
edges.resolution_rule: conduct wins: corrections move in announced stages with the full notice period and a genuine scope-reduction alternative, and a gap the practice chooses to keep carrying is documented with a review date rather than closed abruptly

edges.why_related: a leveled seasonal fee looks like poor contribution in quiet months and excellent contribution in peak months, so monthly ranking misreads seasonal accounts
edges.resolution_rule: seasonal accounts are judged on a rolling annual contribution rather than a single month, and any exit or correction decision for them must cite the annual view explicitly

edges.why_related: firing a client removes recurring revenue immediately while the capacity it releases may not refill for cycles, so the economics argue against every individual exit
edges.resolution_rule: exit proceeds when a written criterion is met and the intervention ladder is exhausted; the revenue argument may change the timing to align with a queued admission, never the decision itself, and quality debt or boundary pressure overrides timing entirely

edges.why_related: unpriced work absorbed month after month is the main mechanism by which a healthy account slides underwater without any fee changing
clients who actually use the reporting are the ones who can describe the value to a peer, so referral capacity is produced by report usefulness rather than by asking harder
the review call is where questions belonging to the tax professional surface and get routed, which is the repeated act that builds the professional relationship
accumulated underpricing is what turns a fully occupied book into a stagnant one, and it only becomes visible when the carried gap is composed at portfolio level
a full measurement cycle must complete before a review cycle opens, or the evidence pack is built on memory
requests and business changes disclosed on the call are routed immediately afterwards while the context is fresh and the decision is still small
when the distress protocol reaches its stated limit without resolution the account moves into the exit sequence rather than drifting on unpaid
the review compares predicted capacity against what the seats actually delivered and sends the correction back into the derivation
an exit releases capacity that flows back through the gate and turns a queued prospect into an admission
clustered disengagement signals in a cohort are evidence that the packet or its timing is failing that cohort, not that those clients are individually difficult
every routed add-on, rung move and logged goodwill instance updates what the ledger expects an account to consume, sharpening the next capacity and contribution pass

both are high-stakes written-first conversations with the same skeleton - evidence, notice period, options, plain statement of the decision, and a record of what was offered - so a practice that can run one can run the other

conflict_axes.name: growth_pressure_versus_delivery_capacity
conflict_axes.description: Every sold client raises recurring revenue immediately and consumes delivery capacity that the existing book already depends on; the practice feels the revenue this month and the overload two months later.
poles: admit the client now and absorb it
hold the capacity ceiling and defer the start
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the derived capacity band with its reserve is the ceiling; overflow goes to a dated queue, a different seat, or a later start, and never to an unannounced overload of the paying book

conflict_axes.name: fixed_fee_certainty_versus_variable_client_workload
conflict_axes.description: The client bought certainty and the practice sold it, but the underlying work fluctuates with the client's own business, so someone must carry the variance every month.
poles: absorb variance to protect the fixed-fee promise
convert variance into rung moves and priced add-ons
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: absorb ordinary month-to-month noise inside the rung, and treat a sustained shift in scope units as a rung question rather than as noise, using the drift log rather than impressions to tell them apart

conflict_axes.name: client_goodwill_versus_charging_for_extra_work
conflict_axes.description: Refusing to absorb a small request looks petty and risks the warmth the subscription depends on, while absorbing it repeatedly is an unbudgeted fee reduction that nobody ever decided to grant.
poles: absorb it to keep the relationship easy
name and price every out-of-scope task
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: name the work in the cycle it appears, allow a small number of logged goodwill instances as a conscious choice, and force the second instance of any class into a priced destination or a rung conversation

conflict_axes.name: price_correction_speed_versus_relationship_notice
conflict_axes.description: The larger the accumulated underpricing, the more the practice wants to correct it in one move, and the more damaging one move is to a client who has heard nothing about it for years.
poles: correct to current pricing at once
stage the correction over announced steps
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: stage against the announced cadence with full notice and a real scope-reduction alternative; single-step corrections are reserved for accounts whose scope changed structurally and recently, and are never retroactive

conflict_axes.name: saving_every_client_versus_portfolio_quality
conflict_axes.description: Retention effort is finite, and spending it on accounts that are structurally leaving or chronically mis-fitted starves the accounts that could be kept and the capacity that could be released.
poles: try to save every account
release mis-fits and concentrate effort
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: diagnose cause before responding: fixable causes get the ladder, structural causes get a good exit, and mis-fit causes go to the exit criteria rather than to another concession

conflict_axes.name: being_helpful_versus_the_licensed_boundary
conflict_axes.description: The most valued moments in a recurring relationship are exactly the ones where an owner asks a tax, structure or financing question that the practice must not answer.
poles: answer the question and be maximally useful
stop, refer, and risk seeming unhelpful
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the boundary is absolute regardless of retention cost: state what the books show, name the question, refer it, document it, and offer to prepare the detail the licensed professional needs

conflict_axes.name: reporting_depth_versus_owner_attention
conflict_axes.description: More complete reporting demonstrates more work and satisfies the practice's own standards, while the owner reads at most a page and only acts on what is immediately legible.
poles: deliver complete financial detail
lead with the few measures the owner acts on
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: lead with the cohort's decision-relevant measures and a plain-language note on what changed, keep the full statements available behind it, and let recorded use signals rather than professional pride settle the layout

conflict_axes.name: seasonal_cash_relief_versus_level_capacity_commitment
conflict_axes.description: A seasonal client wants to pay less when nothing is happening, while the practice holds the account, the knowledge and often the slot all year and must staff the peak.
poles: reduce or pause the fee in quiet months
hold a level annualized fee
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: choose the mechanism in writing before the first quiet month - leveled annual scope, a genuinely reduced dormant tier, or a pause with a stated capacity consequence - and judge the account on rolling annual contribution

conflict_axes.name: referral_growth_versus_client_confidentiality
conflict_axes.description: The most persuasive referral material is a real client's situation and numbers, and that is exactly the material the practice is least free to use.
poles: use client evidence to win the introduction
share nothing without specific written permission
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: confidentiality wins by default: use only permissioned material, speak in general trade mechanics otherwise, and make introductions by connecting people rather than by forwarding financial detail

conflict_axes.name: commercial_pressure_versus_care_for_a_struggling_owner
conflict_axes.description: An owner in cash distress is both the account most likely to accept a bad deal under pressure and the account most expensive to carry unpaid, so the practice's interest and the owner's are genuinely opposed for a while.
poles: press for payment or an upgrade while the owner is anxious
slow down, offer written options and accept the carrying cost
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: care obligations bind first - written options, no same-call commitments, no fear framing - and the practice protects itself with a stated limit on continued unpaid delivery rather than with pressure

edge_cases.description: A steady service client launches an online marketplace channel mid-year and transaction volume, payout reconciliation and channel count all jump while the fee stays at the rung it was priced for
edge_cases.trigger: a client's business model changes structurally without any conversation with the practice
edge_cases.mitigation: the drift log fires on scope-unit counts in the same cycle, the change is named factually with evidence, and the account is routed to a rung review off-cycle rather than absorbed until the annual review

edge_cases.description: A client hires an in-house bookkeeper but asks to keep the subscription for review and reporting only, at the same fee for far less work in one month and unpredictable work in the next
edge_cases.trigger: a structural change in the client's own capability during a live subscription
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the hire as a structural signal rather than a save opportunity, re-scope explicitly into a defined smaller service with its own fee and boundaries, and decline an undefined oversight role that would carry responsibility without control

edge_cases.description: The client's tax professional requests direct access to the accounting file and a set of working papers in the middle of the year
edge_cases.trigger: a third party the practice has no engagement with asks for client data
edge_cases.mitigation: no access or information passes without the client's documented authorization; access is then granted at least privilege through the client's own user management and recorded, and revoked when the purpose ends

edge_cases.description: On a friendly review call the owner asks whether they should change entity type before year-end and whether a large purchase can be written off
edge_cases.trigger: a licensed-territory question arrives inside a warm recurring conversation
edge_cases.mitigation: state what the books show, name the question as one for their tax professional, offer to prepare the ledger detail that professional needs, record the exchange and the referral, and never characterize a position as allowable or safe

edge_cases.description: A lender asks the practice to confirm or sign off that a client's financial statements are accurate as part of a loan application
edge_cases.trigger: a third party requests assurance the practice is not licensed or engaged to give
edge_cases.mitigation: decline any certification, assurance or opinion language, supply only the factual bookkeeping records the client authorizes, refer the request to a licensed professional, and verify current rules in your jurisdiction before responding in writing

edge_cases.description: A client stops paying for two cycles while continuing to send documents and expect delivery, and the practice holds unposted work and the accounting-system access
edge_cases.trigger: non-payment during live delivery with the practice holding the client's records and access
edge_cases.mitigation: make early written contact with structured options and a stated limit, never use records or access as leverage, and take the records-return and work-stop position from the engagement terms plus current local rules verified with a qualified professional

edge_cases.description: A CPA sends a referral whose owner expects the monthly fee to include the tax return and year-end filings because that is what they were told informally
edge_cases.trigger: a referral arrives with an expectation that crosses the practice boundary
edge_cases.mitigation: correct the expectation in writing before admission, restate what is and is not included and who does the return, and feed the misunderstanding back to the referring professional so the next introduction is framed correctly

edge_cases.description: The practice's earliest client pays an original low fee for a scope that has quadrupled and is also the source of several introductions inside a trade association
edge_cases.trigger: the largest legacy price gap sits on the account with the highest referral value
edge_cases.mitigation: quantify the gap, choose deliberately between staged correction and documented acceptance with a review date and a named reason, and never leave the choice implicit or handle it by quietly reducing service

edge_cases.description: A delivery seat is lost suddenly to illness or resignation in the week before month-end with the book sitting at the top of its capacity band
edge_cases.trigger: a capacity shock during close week
edge_cases.mitigation: freeze admissions immediately, re-sequence by data-arrival reliability and external deadlines, notify affected clients of revised dates in writing before they are missed, and re-derive the band before intake reopens

edge_cases.description: A seasonal client asks to pause for four quiet months and return afterwards, expecting their slot and their fee to be waiting
edge_cases.trigger: a pause request that implicitly reserves capacity at no charge
edge_cases.mitigation: state the capacity consequence in writing before agreeing: either a reduced dormant tier that keeps the ledger current and the slot held, or a genuine pause with the slot released and re-entry through the admission gate on return

edge_cases.description: An owner discloses a serious personal or business crisis on a review call and in the same conversation asks whether they should upgrade to get more help
edge_cases.trigger: an upgrade opportunity appears at the exact moment an owner is most vulnerable
edge_cases.mitigation: do not close anything on that call; send the options in writing with what each includes and costs, allow time, avoid any consequence framing, and route any insolvency, tax-deferral or restructuring question to a licensed professional immediately

edge_cases.description: A client insists on emailing the master login for their banking and accounting systems because adding a user is inconvenient
edge_cases.trigger: a client offers shared credentials through an insecure channel
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse the shared credential every time with the same short explanation, walk the client through adding a named user at least privilege, treat any credential already sent as exposed and require it to be changed, and log the incident

workflow.action: State the economics of the existing book and its five levers
workflow.description: Write down how recurring revenue is produced and what each lever is bounded by, so later capacity, pricing, retention and exit decisions are argued in the same terms
workflow.gate: all five levers are named with their bound, each traces to the node that governs it, and every quantity is marked measured or awaiting measurement

workflow.action: Write the licensed-boundary card and rehearse the stop-and-refer move
workflow.description: List the trigger questions that arrive in live accounts, the script that stops and refers, and the documentation rule, before any recurring review conversation is scheduled
workflow.artifact: boundary card with trigger list, script and referral log format
workflow.gate: the card exists, every delivery seat has rehearsed it, and it carries the instruction to verify current jurisdiction rules with a qualified professional

workflow.action: Establish the access and confidentiality lifecycle for live accounts
workflow.description: Record every live grant against a named person and purpose, set the review interval, and define the revocation and retention steps that close an account
workflow.artifact: access register with review interval and closure checklist
workflow.gate: every live grant maps to a named current person through client-side user management, and the revocation and retention steps are written

workflow.action: Run the recurring effort ledger for a full cycle
workflow.description: Capture categorized delivery effort per account across a complete cycle including month-end and any quarter-end spike, with goodwill logged separately
workflow.artifact: per-account categorized effort record for one complete cycle
workflow.gate: every live account has a full cycle captured by category, the goodwill category is populated or its emptiness explained, and no capture gap exceeds the practice tolerance

workflow.action: Derive the capacity band per seat
workflow.description: Compute accounts per seat from available delivery hours after non-delivery load, less the reserve, divided by rung-weighted measured effort, and attach the quality promise
workflow.artifact: dated capacity band per seat with reserve and quality promise
workflow.gate: the band states accounts at a named turnaround and review depth, cites its ledger window, and names its recheck condition

workflow.action: Shape the month and the year across seats
workflow.description: Assign promised delivery dates by cohort and data-arrival reliability, pair counter-seasonal accounts, and leave deliberate slack in close week
workflow.artifact: delivery calendar with per-account promised dates and slack
workflow.gate: each account has a recorded promised date with its data-arrival assumption and the calendar shows unallocated slack in close week

workflow.action: Build the contribution view and tag every underwater account
workflow.description: Set each fee against measured cost-to-serve under a written allocation rule and tag each shortfall as behaviour, complexity or legacy
workflow.artifact: contribution ranking with cause tags and routed actions
workflow.gate: every account has a contribution line from ledger data, the allocation rule is written and unchanged or its change documented, and every shortfall carries a cause tag

workflow.description: Make admission answer the four gate questions against the target seat, with deferral, reassignment or an honest queue as the only alternatives
workflow.artifact: admission rule with per-admission gate record and queue register
workflow.gate: the rule is written, the last cycle's admissions each record seat, headroom and the four answers, and any exception is logged with its authoriser

workflow.action: Turn on scope-drift sensing with same-cycle naming
workflow.description: Track scope-unit counts against what each tier assumed, watch effort rising without a rung change, and name drift in the cycle it appears
workflow.artifact: per-account drift log with dated evidence entries
workflow.gate: each live account has a current scope-unit count and every drift item logged has a date, evidence and a destination decision or explicit deferral

workflow.action: Publish the repricing cadence and its off-cycle triggers
workflow.description: Fix and disclose the review interval, name the triggers that move an account early, and define the evidence pack every decision must rest on
workflow.artifact: published cadence with trigger list and evidence-pack template
workflow.gate: the cadence and triggers are documented and disclosed to clients, and the template requires measured effort, scope counts, drift log and price history with no external benchmark permitted

workflow.action: Make the reporting and the review conversation an instrument rather than a courtesy
workflow.description: Set the agenda, the written note format and the frequency per rung, with the packet leading on the measures each cohort acts on and boundary questions routed on the spot
workflow.artifact: review agenda, note template and per-account cadence record
workflow.gate: every call in the last cycle produced a written note with decisions, open items and client obligations, and boundary questions appear with their referral

workflow.action: Run the periodic book health review and close its decisions
workflow.description: Compose capacity load, contribution, drift and goodwill, price debt, risk register, admissions and exits, and concentration, then decide with owners and dates
workflow.artifact: book health review record with decisions, owners and dates
workflow.gate: all composed inputs are present or explicitly marked missing, every decision has an owner and date, and the self-check on boundary, access, concessions and written fee changes is recorded

dominance_rules.rule: The licensed-professional boundary dominates client helpfulness, retention value and fee opportunity
dominance_rules.rationale: crossing into tax positions, attest or legal judgment creates harm and exposure that no amount of recurring revenue offsets, and the crossing usually happens verbally in a warm conversation
dominance_rules.trigger: a client, lender or referrer asks for advice, certification or an opinion that requires a licence or an engagement the practice does not hold
dominance_rules.action: state what the books show, name the question, refer it to the licensed professional, record the exchange, and verify current jurisdiction rules before any written response

dominance_rules.rule: Client confidentiality and least-privilege access dominate referral, marketing and convenience value
dominance_rules.rationale: the practice holds continuing access to client money systems and financial detail, and a single unauthorized disclosure or shared credential is unrecoverable
dominance_rules.trigger: any request to share client information, use a client story, or accept or grant access outside the recorded lifecycle
dominance_rules.action: require specific written client permission or documented authorization first, grant at least privilege through client-side user management, and refuse shared credentials every time

dominance_rules.rationale: capacity spent on a new account is taken from clients already paying, and the resulting quality failure costs more accounts than the new one adds
dominance_rules.trigger: a sold or referred client would push a seat past its capacity band and reserve
dominance_rules.action: defer the start, reassign to another seat, or queue with an honest expectation, and log any exception with its authoriser at the next book review

dominance_rules.rule: Disclosure-first conduct dominates the timing and delivery of any fee or scope change
dominance_rules.rationale: a change delivered by surprise or under pressure destroys more relationship value than the change recovers, and it is the behaviour the practice would least like described in a niche community
dominance_rules.trigger: a fee increase, scope reduction, policy change or termination is decided
dominance_rules.action: issue it in writing with the effective date and contractual notice period before discussing it, offer a genuine smaller-scope alternative, and never apply it to a period already delivered

dominance_rules.rule: Care for an owner under strain dominates the commercial opportunity in that conversation
dominance_rules.rationale: a distressed owner will agree to things they cannot sustain, and an agreement obtained that way is both harmful and worthless
dominance_rules.trigger: an owner discloses cash distress, illness, bereavement or crisis, or shows signs of being overwhelmed
dominance_rules.action: stop selling, put options in writing, take no same-call commitment, avoid consequence framing, and refer insolvency, restructuring or tax-deferral questions to a licensed professional

dominance_rules.rule: A client's entitlement to their records dominates any fee dispute
dominance_rules.rationale: withholding records as leverage harms the client's ability to run and file, and it is the conduct most likely to breach professional or legal obligations and to be repeated in the niche community
dominance_rules.trigger: an exit or work-stop decision while a balance is unpaid or a dispute is open
dominance_rules.action: hand over the records the client is entitled to per the engagement terms and current local rules verified with a qualified professional, and pursue the balance through legitimate means only

dominance_rules.rule: The promised close quality dominates the marginal account
dominance_rules.rationale: a book that only fits by skipping review or slipping delivery is trading a visible, durable promise for a temporary fee
dominance_rules.trigger: the only way to fit the current or incoming load is to shorten review, skip a check or move a promised date
dominance_rules.action: hold the quality promise, move the load or the start date instead, and treat repeated collisions as evidence that capacity, not effort, is the constraint

dominance_rules.rule: Measured effort dominates memory and impression in every pricing, capacity and exit decision
dominance_rules.rationale: recalled effort systematically understates chasing, communication and goodwill, which is exactly where fixed-fee margin leaks
dominance_rules.trigger: a fee, rung, capacity or exit decision is proposed without ledger data behind it
dominance_rules.action: defer the decision until a measured cycle exists, or mark the decision explicitly as provisional pending measurement

dominance_rules.rule: Written scope dominates accumulated verbal expectation inside a live account
dominance_rules.rationale: silent absorption converts into an expectation that later feels like a takeaway when named, which is how good relationships end badly
dominance_rules.trigger: work outside the rung is requested or has quietly started
dominance_rules.action: name it in the cycle it appears and route it to a priced add-on, a rung move, a logged goodwill instance, or a decline with referral - never to silent absorption

dominance_rules.rule: Service repair dominates commercial concession when a client shows risk
dominance_rules.rationale: most dissatisfaction is a delivery or expectation defect, and paying for it with a discount hides the defect while training the book that complaining lowers fees
dominance_rules.trigger: an at-risk signal fires on an account and a discount is proposed as the response
dominance_rules.action: diagnose the cause, repair service and reset expectations first, and grant a concession only as a dated, conditioned option equally available to any comparable client

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run a full measured cycle of the effort ledger before deriving capacity, ranking contribution or repricing anything
anti_rework_rules.prevents: capacity bands, contribution rankings and fee corrections built on remembered time, which point at the wrong accounts and must be redone once real data arrives

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the licensed-boundary card and rehearse it before scheduling the first recurring review call
anti_rework_rules.prevents: advisory drift established as a habit in warm calls, which cannot be withdrawn later without the client experiencing it as a service reduction

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define and disclose the repricing cadence at engagement rather than when the first increase is needed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: every future fee change being read as a reaction or an ambush, and the years of silence that end in one relationship-breaking correction

anti_rework_rules.rule: Log goodwill and out-of-scope tasks at the moment they are performed, not at review time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an invisible drift history that makes the eventual rung conversation feel arbitrary and impossible to evidence

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the promised delivery date per cohort against data-arrival reality before promising anything to a new account
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a book whose promises all land in the same three days, forcing later renegotiation of dates with clients who were already told

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the mis-fit exit criteria while every client relationship is calm
anti_rework_rules.prevents: exits driven by a bad week that later look arbitrary, damage the practice reputation in a small niche, and cannot be defended if challenged

anti_rework_rules.rule: Agree the seasonal mechanism in writing before the client's first quiet month
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an emergency renegotiation in the month the client has least cash and least patience, usually settled by an undated discount that never ends

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the client's written authorization before any information passes to a referring or engaged professional
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a confidentiality breach that cannot be undone and that ends both the client relationship and the professional referral source

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix reporting usefulness and delivery reliability before offering any retention concession
anti_rework_rules.prevents: paying a discount to cover a service defect, which leaves the defect in place, spreads the discount expectation, and repeats next cycle

anti_rework_rules.rule: Check capacity headroom on the target seat before a start date is promised to a sold or referred client
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an admission that quietly breaks promised dates across the existing book and forces apologies, rework and sometimes multiple exits

iteration_protocol.trigger: measured effort for an account or cohort diverges materially from what its rung assumed for two consecutive cycles
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the capacity band, re-rank contribution, and open an off-cycle rung review for the affected accounts

iteration_protocol.trigger: a capacity shock hits a seat through illness, departure, leave or an unexpected cleanup inside a supposedly steady account
iteration_protocol.action: freeze admissions, re-sequence the calendar by data arrival and external deadlines, notify affected clients in writing before dates are missed, and re-derive the band before intake reopens

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same out-of-scope class appears across several accounts in one niche
iteration_protocol.action: stop treating it as per-account drift, decide once whether it belongs in a rung or an add-on, and hand the pattern upstream to the offer owners as evidence the tier definition is wrong

iteration_protocol.trigger: engagement signals fall across a cohort rather than on individual accounts
iteration_protocol.action: treat it as a reporting and cadence failure, redesign the packet and the review rhythm for that cohort, and re-measure use signals before any commercial response

iteration_protocol.trigger: a client leaves, is exited, or a save fails
iteration_protocol.action: run the exit review against the signals that fired and the interventions attempted, update the signal set and the admission criteria, and route released capacity through the gate

iteration_protocol.trigger: referral inflow exceeds what the admission gate can absorb for two consecutive cycles
iteration_protocol.action: hold a managed queue with honest expectations, decide whether the constraint justifies added capacity, and tell the referring professionals and communities what the real start horizon is

iteration_protocol.trigger: the aggregate carried legacy price gap passes the tolerance the practice set for itself
iteration_protocol.action: schedule staged corrections in the next cadence window, offer scope-reduction alternatives, and record a reason and review date for any gap deliberately kept

iteration_protocol.trigger: a boundary, confidentiality or access incident occurs, including a near miss
iteration_protocol.action: stop, document what happened, correct the exposure, re-rehearse the boundary or access step with every seat, and verify current obligations in the practice jurisdiction with a qualified professional before changing the standing rule

priority_rationale: The economics model and the effort ledger come first because every capacity, pricing, retention and exit judgment in this subdomain is arithmetic on measured delivery load, and a decision made from memory misidentifies which accounts are the problem; the boundary, access and conduct nodes sit alongside them because they bind from the first conversation and cannot be retrofitted once advisory drift, shared credentials or pressure tactics have become habits; capacity derivation, calendar shaping and the admission gate follow because they convert measurement into the ceiling that protects the paying book; scope-drift sensing and routing precede repricing because a fee argument is only evidenced if the drift was named when it appeared; the retention instruments - useful reporting, the structured review call, the risk signal set and the intervention ladder - build on that base because they depend on delivery actually being reliable; distress, seasonality and mis-fit exit come next as the bounded ways a relationship ends or contracts; referral engines come after the delivery experience they advertise, since a referral built on an unreliable service damages the source; and the book health review sits last because it composes every other output into portfolio decisions with owners and dates.
